title: tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction
why_read: A plugin for Claude Code that changes how conversation history gets summarized during compaction, a practical detail for engineers using long-running AI coding sessions.
analysis: 'Compaction' in AI coding assistants refers to summarizing older conversation history to fit within a model's context window as a session grows long. This plugin reportedly replaces the default summary with a scoring system that decides, per tool call and result, whether to keep it verbatim, truncate it, or drop it entirely, aiming to preserve more useful detail than a generic summary would. This is a fairly niche but genuinely useful engineering detail for people building or heavily using long AI coding sessions, since context management quality directly affects agent reliability.
